scope: Proposition A.2 (A two-spin example) of the manuscript “Critical slowing down in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-slowing-down-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 20041aa4df40c551), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For n = 2 and the discrete uniform-site heat-bath kernel, the mixing time has no finite deterministic essential upper bound over the Gaussian coupling, although it is finite for every realization.
